findings.title: Use parsed version when reconciling valid versionless v1 approvals
findings.body: The new approval['schema_version'] lookups fail for v1 records omitting this optional/defaulted field. Product loading/export and the baseline reconciler accept the same source-bound record, but the reviewed patch raises KeyError, preventing historical reconciliation and any batch replay using that prior review. Use the parsed decision.schema_version without rewriting historical records.
findings.status: Coordinator repaired during review; independent rerun passed.

findings.title: Compare equivalent v1/v2 publication content as the same intent
findings.body: decision_intent includes every v2 omission tuple but no v1 omissions. Thus a v1 single-span approval and a v2 approval retaining exactly that span while removing only a publication notice conflict despite identical narrative and no separately published blurb. The real cumulative inventory becomes conflict and prior historical-baseline reconciliation is lost. Normalize intent to retained spans and separately preserved blurb ranges; preserve conflicts when blurb placement differs.
findings.status: Coordinator confirmed unintended and is repairing; not rechecked in this initial report.
